name.description: The name given to the API Token.

id.description: The ID generated by Turso for the API Token.

organization.description: The organization slug this token is restricted to. Omitted if the token has access to all organizations.

group.description: The group name this token is pinned to. Present only for group-scoped tokens.

scopes.description: The expanded list of scopes granted to this token. Present only for group-scoped tokens. Presets passed at creation time (`read-only`, `full-access`) are stored as the underlying individual scopes and are returned in that form.

created_at.description: The date the token was created, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
